name: Higuchi Maya
source:
A man who was kidnapped by [url=/c113890]Satori[/url] and had his hands and eyes gouged out.

Although he has a higher brain than usual, he has been neglected by those around him, so his self-esteem is strangely low.

[Translated from [url=https://maduzudz.wixsite.com/marutoku/%E8%A4%87%E8%A3%BD-zeno-4]official website[/url]]
